title: Preliminary Analysis of Aging-Related Genes in Intracerebral Hemorrhage by Integration of Bulk and Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Technology.
authors: Li, Qianfeng; Wang, Bo; Yang, Jun; Wang, Yuan; Duan, Faliang; Luo, Ming; Zhao, Chungang; Wei, Wei; Wang, Lei; Liu, Sha
one_liner_zh: 该文通过批量与单细胞RNA测序分析脑出血衰老相关基因，虽构建了TF-mRNA调控网络，但核心是基因表达与免疫浸润，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Aging is recognized as the key risk for intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH). The detailed mechanisms of aging in ICH warrant exploration. This study aimed to identify potential aging-related genes associated with ICH. METHODS: ICH-specific aging-related genes were determined by the intersection of differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between perihematomal tissues and corresponding contralateral parts of four patients with ICH (GSE24265) and 349 aging-related genes obtained from the Aging Atlas database. Gene Ontology (GO), Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) and Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) analyses were performed to identify the potential biological functions and pathways in which these ICH-specific aging-related genes may be involved. Then, PPI network was established to identify the hub genes of ICH-specific aging-related genes. Meanwhile, miRNA-mRNA and transcription factor (TF)-mRNA regulatory networks were constructed to further explore the ICH-specific aging-related genes regulation. The relationship between these hub genes and immune infiltration was also further explored. Additional single-cell RNA-seq analysis (scRNA-seq, GSE167593) was used to locate the hub genes in different cell types. Besides, expression levels of the hub genes were validated using clinical samples from our institute and another GEO dataset (GSE206971). RESULTS: This study identified 24 ICH-specific aging-related genes, including 22 up-regulated and 2 down-regulated genes. The results of GO and KEGG suggested that the ICH-specific aging-related genes mainly enriched in immunity and inflammation-related pathways, suggesting that aging may affect the ich pathogenesis by regulating inflammatory and immune-related pathways. CONCLUSION: Our study revealed 24 ICH-specific aging-related genes and their functions highly pertinent to ICH pathogenesis, providing new insights into the impact of aging on ICH.
abstract_zh: 背景：衰老被认为是脑出血（ICH）的关键风险因素。衰老在ICH中的具体机制尚待探索。本研究旨在识别与ICH相关的潜在衰老相关基因。方法：通过比较四名ICH患者（GSE24265）血肿周围组织与相应对侧部分的差异表达基因（DEGs）与从Aging Atlas数据库获取的349个衰老相关基因的交集，确定了ICH特异性衰老相关基因。进行了基因本体论（GO）、京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）和基因集富集分析（GSEA），以识别这些ICH特异性衰老相关基因可能涉及的潜在生物学功能和通路。随后，建立了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络以识别ICH特异性衰老相关基因的核心基因。同时，构建了miRNA-mRNA和转录因子（TF）-mRNA调控网络，以进一步探索ICH特异性衰老相关基因的调控机制。还进一步探讨了这些核心基因与免疫浸润之间的关系。额外的单细胞RNA测序分析（scRNA-seq，GSE167593）用于定位不同细胞类型中的核心基因。此外，使用来自本研究所和另一个GEO数据集（GSE206971）的临床样本验证了核心基因的表达水平。结果：本研究识别出24个ICH特异性衰老相关基因，包括22个上调基因和2个下调基因。GO和KEGG结果表明，ICH特异性衰老相关基因主要富集于免疫和炎症相关通路，提示衰老可能通过调节炎症和免疫相关通路影响ICH发病机制。结论：我们的研究揭示了24个ICH特异性衰老相关基因及其与ICH发病机制高度相关的功能，为衰老对ICH的影响提供了新的见解。
